# HERMES station WebSocket API reference (`hermes.v1`)

<!-- GENERATED by api/spec/gen_reference.py from api/spec/api-ws.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

One WebSocket per client at `/api/v2/ws`, for live state, events and commands. **11 of 13 commands** and **7 of 15 topics** are implemented in this build; the others are *planned*.

How to connect and use it: [API-USAGE.md](API-USAGE.md#8-real-time-websocket). The REST API: [API-REFERENCE.md](API-REFERENCE.md). The contract: [`api/spec/api-ws.yaml`](../api/spec/api-ws.yaml) (version `1.0.0-draft.1`).

## Connecting

- `GET /api/v2/ws` with `Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: hermes.v1`.
- Authenticate with the REST session: the `hermes_session` cookie (browsers send it by themselves, and
  must come from the station's own origin) or `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (tools). No session: 401.
- The session's role gates every command. `readonly` may subscribe but runs no commands.
- The first frame is `hello`; a `heartbeat` follows every 5 s. A client silent for 60 s is disconnected.
- A command carries a client-chosen `id` and gets exactly one `reply` with that `id`.
- Subscribing sends a full snapshot (`snapshot: true`), then only what changed, at most 10 events a
  second per topic. `seq` counts events per topic; on a gap, subscribe again for a new snapshot.

## Frames from the client

| Frame | Fields |
| --- | --- |
| `subscribe` | `{"type":"subscribe","id":"1","topics":["radio.state"]}` |
| `unsubscribe` | `{"type":"unsubscribe","id":"2","topics":["radio.state"]}` |
| `cmd` | `{"type":"cmd","id":"42","cmd":"radio.set","args":{...}}` |

## Frames from the station

| Frame | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `hello` | First frame: your `role`, `user`, `locale`, the `topics` and `commands` available to you, and `limits`. |
| `heartbeat` | Every 5 s, with the station clock `ts`. |
| `reply` | The answer to a `subscribe`, `unsubscribe` or `cmd`: `{"type":"reply","id":...,"ok":true,"data":...}` or `"ok":false` with `error: {code, message}`. |
| `event` | A topic's snapshot or change: `{"type":"event","topic":...,"seq":...,"ts":...,"snapshot":...,"data":...}`. |
| binary | Spectrum frames (kinds 3 and 4), to subscribers of `radio.spectrum.*` and `modem.spectrum.rx`. |

<a id="args-radiosetargs"></a>
### radio.set (operator)

Any of these, in one call; all are validated before any is applied. Without
`profile`, the active profile.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `profile` | integer |  | min 0 |
| `frequency_hz` | integer |  | min 0 |
| `mode` | [Mode](API-REFERENCE.md#schema-mode) |  |  |
| `power` | integer |  | min 0; max 100 |
| `volume` | integer |  | min 0; max 100 |
| `filter_width_hz` | integer |  |  |
| `digital_voice` | boolean |  |  |

<a id="args-riggetargs"></a>
### rig.get (operator)

Read the radio's controls now; the reply carries their values. The names are radiod's control vocabulary (`radio/radio_controls.h`), the same on every radio backend (sBitx, Hamlib rigs); they follow Hamlib's spelling.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `names` | array of string | yes |  |

<a id="args-rigsetargs"></a>
### rig.set (operator)

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `value` | number or boolean | yes |  |

<a id="args-rigwatchargs"></a>
### rig.watch (operator)

The controls `radio.rig` events report for this client; an empty list stops.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `names` | array of string | yes |  |
| `interval_ms` | integer |  | min 250; default `1000` |

<a id="args-digisendargs"></a>
### digi.send (operator)

Sent in the active profile's mode (FT8, CW or RTTY), as hermes-radio-daemon does
today. `mode`, when given, must match it: a guard against sending in a mode the
operator didn't expect (`wrong_mode`). Change the mode first with `radio.set`. The
reply says the text is queued; the `digi` topic reports it as `tx` when it goes out.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | one of `FT8`, `CW`, `RTTY` |  |  |
| `text` | string | yes | FT8 free text is at most 13 characters. CW and RTTY text without the station callsign gets ` de <callsign>` appended; max length 256 |

<a id="args-recordingargs"></a>
### recording.start / recording.stop (operator)

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stream` | one of `rx`, `tx`, `both` |  | default `both` |

<a id="args-rtcofferargs"></a>
### rtc.offer (user; operator with tx)

Start or renegotiate this socket's WebRTC audio session. The reply's `data` is
`{sdp}`, the station's answer, with its host candidates in it.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sdp` | string | yes | The client's SDP offer, with its ICE candidates gathered; max length 16384 |
| `rx` | boolean |  | Receive the station's audio; default `True` |
| `tx` | boolean |  | Send microphone audio (operator); default `False` |

<a id="args-chatsendargs"></a>
### modem.chat.send (user)

The broadcast plane sends in the station's listen mode (`modem.config.listen_mode`).
The `arq` plane needs an ARQ session up; without one the reply is `no_link`.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `plane` | one of `arq`, `broadcast` | yes |  |
| `text` | string | yes | max length 1024 |

### Reply error codes

`bad_request`, `unknown_cmd`, `missing_arg`, `out_of_range`, `forbidden`, `busy`, `rig_timeout`, `not_supported`, `no_ptt`, `wrong_mode`, `no_link`, `queue_full`, `rate_limited`, `tx_timeout`, `internal`

### `digi`

One event per FT8 decode, CW or RTTY line, D-STAR header, and per digital-mode transmission (`dir: tx`). The snapshot is what radiod keeps in memory (its last 64 entries); older ones are in `GET /digi/log`.

### `modem.status`

### `modem.config`

Operator role and above.

### `modem.chat`

Mercury's keyboard chat (ARQ and broadcast). The snapshot is the stored history.

### `messages`

A message arrived, or a message's state changed. The UI stops polling the inbox. An outgoing broadcast on the air sends `updated` at most once a second, with `broadcast.frames_sent`; a withdrawn incoming one sends `updated` with `broadcast.withdrawn_at`.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | one of `created`, `received`, `updated`, `read`, `unread`, `deleted` | yes |  |
| `message` | [Message](API-REFERENCE.md#schema-message) | yes |  |

### `queue`

A UUCP job was queued, sent, failed or cancelled; a call started or ended.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | one of `queued`, `sent`, `failed`, `cancelled`, `call_started`, `call_ended` |  |  |
| `job` | [QueueJob](API-REFERENCE.md#schema-queuejob) |  |  |
| `station` | [UucpName](API-REFERENCE.md#schema-uucpname) |  | A station's UUCP system name; pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$` |
| `transport` | [Transport](API-REFERENCE.md#schema-transport) |  | For `call_started` and `call_ended` |

### `system`

Health, disk, clock sync or a service changed state.

### `gps`

The station's own position and fix, or other stations' positions as they arrive over the air. The snapshot is the station's own `Gps` (`change: self`); a `change: peers` event carries the stations whose last-known position changed.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | one of `self`, `peers` | yes |  |
| `gps` | [Gps](API-REFERENCE.md#schema-gps) |  |  |
| `stations` | array of [Station](API-REFERENCE.md#schema-station) |  |  |

### `reticulum`

The node's state, a backhaul link's state, or an LXMF address heard announcing. The snapshot is the node's state and every link.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | one of `status`, `link`, `peer` | yes |  |
| `status` | [ReticulumStatus](API-REFERENCE.md#schema-reticulumstatus) |  |  |
| `link` | [ReticulumLink](API-REFERENCE.md#schema-reticulumlink) |  |  |
| `peer` | [LxmfPeer](API-REFERENCE.md#schema-lxmfpeer) |  |  |

### Binary frames

Little-endian. 12-byte header: `u8 kind`, `u8 version` (1), `u16 flags` (0), `u32 seq`, `u32 sample_rate`.

| kind | Topic | Payload |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 3 | `radio.spectrum.rx`, `modem.spectrum.rx` | `u16 nbins`, `f32 start_hz`, `f32 bin_hz`, `f32 dB x nbins` |
| 4 | `radio.spectrum.tx` | as kind 3 |
